title: Johnny mnemonic
summary: "Johnny Mnemonic" is a cyberpunk story by William Gibson, first published in 1981 and later widely anthologised. It follows Johnny, a data courier whose memory has been surgically altered to carry a stolen corporate program that only one client can unlock with a code phrase. When that client, the Christian White-faced fence Ralfi Face, is murdered by a Yakuza assassin, Johnny is left with a dangerous cargo and hunted by the criminal syndicate that wants it back. He falls in with Molly Millions, a mirror-eyed street samurai with retractable blades, and together they seek help in Nighttown, a lawless slum beneath the roof of a sprawling Fuller-dome city. Their search leads them to Jones, a cyborg dolphin from the navy, and to the Lo Teks, a community of scavengers in the ruins above. The story explores bodily modification, corporate power, and the strain of a mind that is not wholly one's own. Its hard-boiled voice and dense, invented slang helped define the genre.
